<section id="changelog">
<h1>Changelog</h1>
<blockquote>
<div><p><strong>Generated by releaseledger.</strong> Manual edits may be overwritten. Update releaseledger entries and rebuild this file instead.</p>
</div></blockquote>
<p>All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.</p>
<p>The format is based on <a class="reference external" href="https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/">Keep a Changelog</a>, and this project adheres to <a class="reference external" href="https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html">Semantic Versioning</a>.</p>
<section id="id1">
<h2>[0.6.1] - 2026-07-28</h2>
<section id="added">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added recovery assessment and migration inspection CLI commands</p></li>
<li><p>Added MigrationCommandResponse dataclass for framework-neutral CLI output</p></li>
<li><p>Added StorageFingerprint serialization methods (to_mapping, from_mapping)</p></li>
<li><p>Added CLI error types for migration operations</p></li>
<li><p>Added test suite for migration recovery scenarios</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="changed">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Improved migration phase transitions to allow recovery from failed state</p></li>
<li><p>Improved item state transitions for direct pending-to-complete and stage-verified-to-activation paths</p></li>
<li><p>Changed CLI migrate module to add recovery assessment and inspection commands</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="fixed">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed pytest failures in migration module</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed Windows test failures in migration CLI tests</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="id2">
<h2>[0.6.0] - 2026-07-27</h2>
<section id="id3">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added DestinationPrecondition dataclass for typed before-state fingerprints</p></li>
<li><p>Added MigrationPhase and MigrationItemState enums for schema-3 state machine</p></li>
<li><p>Added Schema3MigrationJournal, Schema3ItemJournalState, Schema3ConfigSwitchState dataclasses</p></li>
<li><p>Added write_schema3_journal and _parse_schema3_journal for schema-3 TOML persistence</p></li>
<li><p>Added StorageMigrationHooks for lifecycle callbacks (quiescence, staged/activated validation, finalize)</p></li>
<li><p>Added MigrationLock for advisory project migration locking</p></li>
<li><p>Added _check_same_filesystem and _validate_same_filesystem for cross-filesystem detection</p></li>
<li><p>Added _durable_rename for fsync-backed atomic renames</p></li>
<li><p>Added render_ledger_manifest and render_ledger_local_config for pure TOML rendering</p></li>
<li><p>Added strict plan-structure validation (_validate_plan_structure) for migration_id, policies, strategies, kinds</p></li>
<li><p>Added stage/backup collision detection in _check_path_overlaps</p></li>
<li><p>Added source fingerprint population during planning</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id4">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Changed file fingerprints (sha256-file-v1) to be path-independent (content hash only, no filename)</p></li>
<li><p>Changed fingerprint failures to fail closed: state=’invalid’ instead of ‘owned’ with missing fingerprint</p></li>
<li><p>Changed config inspection to check parent binding even when file is absent</p></li>
<li><p>Changed noop-if-exact to compare against expected_target_fingerprint (not before-state)</p></li>
<li><p>Changed replace-owned to use expected_before.fingerprint for before-state validation</p></li>
<li><p>Changed executor to call validate_storage_migration_plan before first journal write</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id5">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed fail-open validation where fingerprint errors allowed owned+replaceable state</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed missing config file bypassing foreign parent detection</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed unknown destination policies/strategies falling through to default action</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MigrationLock</span></code> creating <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/migrations/write.lock</span></code> with executable
permissions on POSIX; lock files now use private <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0600</span></code> permissions, stale
diagnostics are replaced only after lock acquisition, and failed acquisition
closes the opened descriptor.</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="id6">
<h2>[0.5.0] - 2026-07-17</h2>
<section id="id7">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>BREAKING:</strong> Added a schema-3 storage model with derived paths, binding markers, TOML ownership, and migration</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id8">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Documented per-ledger sibling storage paths and shared project UUID under one root</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="id9">
<h2>[0.5.1] - 2026-07-27</h2>
<section id="id10">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Classified incomplete migration recovery as manual intervention (STORAGE_MIGRATION_MANUAL_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED)</p></li>
<li><p>Disabled explicit mode=move execution (raises STORAGE_MIGRATION_MOVE_DISABLED)</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed codecov test configuration</p></li>
<li><p>Documented Ledgercore 0.5.1 migration containment strategy</p></li>
<li><p>Migrated releaseledger storage to project-local ledger directory</p></li>
<li><p>Added project badges</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed documentation typo</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed pytest configuration</p></li>
<li><p>Added tests to reproduce migration journal validation defects</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id11">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed completed recovery to return truthful source_removed (False for schema-2 copy, None for schema-1)</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed schema-1 journal inspection to use None for unknown bindings instead of fabricating storage=project</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed migration progress metadata in schema-2 journals (items_completed, mode, verify, project_root)</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed exact migration journal binding identity round-trip (source and destination bindings persisted in schema-2 journals)</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="id12">
<h2>[0.2.1] - 2026-06-17</h2>
<section id="id13">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added shared ledger configuration helpers for locating ledger.toml files and selecting project or tool tables</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id14">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Changed core storage and validation behavior for atomic writes, front matter, IDs, and source-tree versions</p></li>
<li><p>Documented Sphinx builds with MyST Markdown and myst-parser dependencies</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="id15">
<h2>[0.2.0] - 2026-06-13</h2>
<section id="id16">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>JSON Lines object storage with deterministic writing, comment support, and recoverable line-level error handling</p></li>
<li><p>SHA-256 content fingerprinting with front matter decomposition for document and metadata hashing</p></li>
<li><p>Path text normalization for Unicode escapes, punctuation, and filesystem-safe slug generation</p></li>
<li><p>FrontMatterRenderOptions with key ordering, remaining key sort control, scalar styling, and template placeholder modes</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id17">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>arc42 architecture documentation covering system context, building blocks, runtime, deployment, and quality requirements</p></li>
<li><p>Version sourcing switched to hatch-vcs for automatic version derivation from git tags</p></li>

<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
